subject: Computação
description_pt: Produzir e publicar conteúdo como textos, imagens, áudios, vídeos e suas associações, bem como ferramentas para sua integração, organização e apresentação, utilizando diferentes mídias digitais.

components.description_pt: Produzir conteúdo digital combinando texto, imagens, áudio e vídeo usando ferramentas apropriadas
components.description_en: Produce digital content combining text, images, audio, and video using appropriate tools
components.cc_component_description: Explain how analog information such as images or sound is converted into digital form using discrete values

components.description_pt: Publicar conteúdo digital em diversas plataformas de mídia digital
components.description_en: Publish digital content across a variety of digital media platforms

components.description_pt: Selecionar ferramentas digitais apropriadas para organizar e apresentar conteúdo multimídia
components.description_en: Select appropriate digital tools to organize and present multimedia content
components.cc_component_description: Select appropriate tools, technologies, or models to analyze a given scientific data set

components.description_pt: Criar ferramentas de integração que combinem múltiplos tipos de mídia digital
components.description_en: Create integration tools that combine multiple types of digital media
components.cc_component_description: Combine information from multiple sources to communicate explanations or design solutions

cc_matches.description: Obtain and combine information from books and/or other reliable media to explain phenomena or solutions to a design problem.

Information can be digitized (e.g., a picture stored as the values of an array of pixels); in this form, it can be stored reliably in computer memory and sent over long distances as a series of wave pulses.
Analyze data using tools, technologies, and/or models (e.g., computational, mathematical) in order to make valid and reliable scientific claims or determine an optimal design solution.
